Every method of `Social`, grouped by resource. Types are under the `Social` namespace (`import type { Social } from "@productcraft/social"`). Every method takes per-request options last (`{ idempotencyKey, timeout, maxRetries, headers, signal, workspaceId }`).

## communities

### `social.communities.analytics(communityId, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/analytics` → `Social.CommunityAnalytics`

Community-level analytics rollup: total active actors, published posts, published comments, open flags, and last-7-day windows for each.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.analytics.read`, or the workspace has not enabled the `social` service. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in this workspace (opaque cross-tenant 404). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const communityAnalytics = await social.communities.analytics("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-analytics)

### `social.communities.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities` → `Social.Community`

Create an social community. `app_id` is optional — when supplied Social connects the community to an Auth app and refuses if the app belongs to a different workspace (cross-tenant gate) or is already connected. Omit `app_id` for a standalone community (no Auth integration; the customer manages actor identity). Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

- Params: `Social.CommunityCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (slug shape, display_name length, malformed Idempotency-Key). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | `app_id` was supplied but no bearer/cookie was forwarded for the upstream Auth fetch. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.create` or workspace has not enabled the `social` service. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | `app_id` supplied but the Auth app was not found in this workspace (opaque cross-tenant 404). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Community slug already taken in this workspace, the supplied `app_id` is already connected to a community, or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` (same Idempotency-Key, different body). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const community = await social.communities.create({ display_name: "My Product Community", slug: "my-product-community" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities)

### `social.communities.delete(communityId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}` → `void`

Delete a community. Cascades to every actor, post, comment, edge, flag, and notification it owns. Not reversible.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.delete`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await social.communities.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#delete-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id)

### `social.communities.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities` → `PagePromise<Social.Community>`

List communities in a workspace, newest-first. Cursor-paginated as of task 008 / G13 (previously a bare array). Optional `?q=` substring search (display name OR slug) and `?status=` filter, both composable with each other and with the cursor — the ordering is fixed, so keep the same filters on every follow-up page.

- Params: `Social.CommunityListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid `status`, over-length `q`, or a malformed cursor. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.list`, or the workspace has not enabled the `social` service. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const community of social.communities.list()) {
  console.log(community);
}
const page = await social.communities.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities)

## communities.moderation.actions

### `social.communities.moderation.actions.create(communityId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/moderation/actions` → `Social.ModerationAction`

Apply a moderation action directly, without a preceding flag (task 017). Acts on any target — post/comment (status), direct_message (moderator soft-delete), or actor (ban=suspend / restore=reinstate). Writes a flag_id=null audit row.

- Params: `Social.CommunityModerationActionCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid target_kind / action / notes. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.moderate`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or target not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const moderationAction = await social.communities.moderation.actions.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", {
  action: "remove",
  target_id: "bbbbbbbb-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
  target_kind: "direct_message",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-moderation-actions)

## communities.moderation.actors

### `social.communities.moderation.actors.shadowBan(communityId, actorId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/moderation/actors/{actor_id}/shadow-ban` → `Social.ModerationActor`

Apply a shadow ban to an actor. The actor sees their own content normally; everyone else sees nothing from them. Pass `duration_hours` for a timed ban or omit for indefinite. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried timed ban doesn't restart the clock.

- Params: `Social.CommunityModerationActorShadowBanParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid duration_hours or reason, or malformed Idempotency-Key. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.moderate`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or actor not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` — the supplied Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const moderationActor = await social.communities.moderation.actors.shadowBan("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { duration_hours: 168 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-moderation-actors-actor-id-shadow-ban)

## communities.moderation.blockedTerms

### `social.communities.moderation.blockedTerms.create(communityId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/moderation/blocked-terms` → `Social.BlockedTerm`

Add a hidden word to the community lexicon. A comment whose body contains the term is routed to `action`: `hide` → lands hidden; `pending_approval` → lands in the approve lane. Re-adding a term updates its action. Case-insensitive.

- Params: `Social.CommunityModerationBlockedTermCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Empty or over-length term. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.config.update`. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const blockedTerm = await social.communities.moderation.blockedTerms.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { term: "spoiler" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-moderation-blocked-terms)

List flags in this community. Filter by ?status=open|dismissed|actioned. 50/page (max 200), cursor-paginated.

- Params: `Social.CommunityModerationFlagListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid status filter. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.moderation.queue.read`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const flag of social.communities.moderation.flags.list("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f")) {
  console.log(flag);
}
const page = await social.communities.moderation.flags.list("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", {}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-moderation-flags)

### `social.communities.moderation.flags.resolve(communityId, flagId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/moderation/flags/{flag_id}/actions` → `Social.ActOnFlag`

Apply a moderation action to a flag. Records an audit entry and updates the target post/comment status. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried request records ONE audit entry, not two.

- Params: `Social.CommunityModerationFlagResolveParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid action or notes, or malformed Idempotency-Key. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.moderate`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or flag not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | FLAG_ALREADY_CLOSED — the flag is already actioned/dismissed and the requested action is punitive (hide/remove/warn/ban); reversals (unhide/restore/dismiss) stay legal on a closed flag. Also `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` (same Idempotency-Key, different body). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const actOnFlag = await social.communities.moderation.flags.resolve("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { action: "hide" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-moderation-flags-flag-id-actions)

## communities.webhooks.endpoints

### `social.communities.webhooks.endpoints.create(communityId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Social.WebhookEndpointWithSecret` · **deprecated**

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

**Deprecated:** The same call as on `/v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks` (in the SDKs: `community(communityId).webhooks`), which SDK code should use. This route exists for signed-in console sessions. Kept for this major; removed from the SDK in the next one.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Social.CommunityWebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found, not visible to the caller, or the endpoint / event is not in it. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await social.communities.webhooks.endpoints.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-webhooks-endpoints)

### `social.communities.webhooks.events.replay(communityId, eventId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}/replay` → `Social.WebhookEventReplay` · **deprecated**

Send a logged event again, to its endpoints or to one endpoint.

**Deprecated:** The same call as on `/v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks` (in the SDKs: `community(communityId).webhooks`), which SDK code should use. This route exists for signed-in console sessions. Kept for this major; removed from the SDK in the next one.

Same body and `webhook-id`, freshly signed, to every switched-on endpoint that receives this event type now, or only to `endpoint_id`. Waits for the receivers (up to 15 s each) and returns the attempts. A success cancels a retry still queued for that endpoint.

- Params: `Social.CommunityWebhookEventReplayParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. Or No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `endpoint_id` is switched off or does not receive this event type (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventReplay = await social.communities.webhooks.events.replay("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-webhooks-events-event-id-replay)

### `social.communities.webhooks.events.retrieve(communityId, eventId, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}` → `Social.WebhookEventDetail` · **deprecated**

Get one webhook event with every delivery attempt.

**Deprecated:** The same call as on `/v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks` (in the SDKs: `community(communityId).webhooks`), which SDK code should use. This route exists for signed-in console sessions. Kept for this major; removed from the SDK in the next one.

The event as it was sent (`type`, `data`) and every delivery attempt to every endpoint, with its trigger, HTTP status, error and the start of the response body. Use it to debug a receiver, then `replay` to send it again.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventDetail = await social.communities.webhooks.events.retrieve("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-communities-community-id-webhooks-events-event-id)

## stats

### `social.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `Social.SocialWorkspaceStats`

Social stats for a workspace.

Community count, published posts, active members, posts, comments and reactions in the window, the most recent activity and a daily active-members series, across every community in the workspace.

**Active** means the member published a post, published a comment or reacted.

Days are UTC. Counts only: no member ids, handles or author lists. Cached for up to 60 seconds (`generated_at`).

- Params: `Social.StatsRetrieveParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `window` is not one of 1d, 7d, 30d. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.analytics.read` on the workspace, or Social is not enabled on it (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found: the id is unknown, is not a UUID, or is not visible to the caller. Same answer as the service's other workspace routes. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const socialWorkspaceStats = await social.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

## webhooks

### `social.webhooks.unwrap({ payload, headers, secret? })`

Verifies the signature and returns `Social.UnwrapWebhookEvent`. Events: `actor.updated`, `asset.failed`, `asset.ready`, `comment.created`, `comment.deleted`, `comment.reaction.created`, `comment.updated`, `dm.message.created`, `edge.follow.created`, `edge.follow.deleted`, `edge.follow.request_approved`, `edge.follow.requested`, `flag.created`, `flag.updated`, `moderation.action.applied`, `post.created`, `post.deleted`, `post.reaction.created`, `post.updated`, `repost.created`, `tag.created`, plus `UnknownWebhookEvent` for types added later.

### `social.webhooks.sign({ payload, secret?, id?, timestamp? })`

Signs a test event exactly as ProductCraft signs deliveries (Standard Webhooks) and returns `{ payload, headers }`, ready for `unwrap` or a request to your handler. For tests; real deliveries come signed.

## webhooks.endpoints

### `social.webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Social.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Social.WebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found, not visible to the caller, or the endpoint / event is not in it. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await social.webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints)

### `social.webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret(endpointId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/rotate-secret` → `Social.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Rotate the signing secret. The new one is returned once.

For `grace_hours` (default 24) the previous secret keeps signing too: `webhook-signature` then lists one `v1,` signature per secret, so receivers can switch over without dropping a delivery.

- Params: `Social.WebhookEndpointRotateSecretParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await social.webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { grace_hours: 24 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints-endpoint-id-rotate-secret)

### `social.webhooks.endpoints.test(endpointId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/test` → `Social.WebhookDeliveryAttempt`

Send a test event to this endpoint now and return the result.

Delivers the catalogue example of `event_type`, signed like any delivery, with `"test": true` in the body. Works while the endpoint is switched off or not subscribed to that type, is logged in the event log, and is never retried or counted toward an automatic disable. Waits up to 15 s for your receiver.

- Params: `Social.WebhookEndpointTestParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |

| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookDeliveryAttempt = await social.webhooks.endpoints.test("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { event_type: "post.created" });
```

Change a webhook endpoint: URL, description, events, on/off.

Only the fields sent change. `enabled: true` (or a new URL) also clears an automatic disable. Switching off cancels queued retries. The secret is unchanged; rotate it with `POST …/rotate-secret`.

- Params: `Social.WebhookEndpointUpdateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The new URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await social.webhooks.endpoints.update("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { description: "Production receiver" });
```

```ts

```

### `social.webhooks.events.retrieve(eventId, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}` → `Social.WebhookEventDetail`

Get one webhook event with every delivery attempt.

The event as it was sent (`type`, `data`) and every delivery attempt to every endpoint, with its trigger, HTTP status, error and the start of the response body. Use it to debug a receiver, then `replay` to send it again.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or Social is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventDetail = await social.webhooks.events.retrieve("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id)

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors/batch` → `Social.BatchActors`

Bulk actor upsert (max 200 per call) — the import lane. Each item runs the exact single-upsert path; results come back per item with partial success (`201` even when some items fail — inspect `success` / `error` per entry). No wrapping transaction.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Envelope validation failure: `actors` missing, empty, over 200 items, or an item shape invalid. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create` for this community. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in the PAK's workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const batchActors = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").actors.batch({ actors: [{ external_id: "user_abc123" }] });
```

### `social.community(…).actors.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors` → `Social.UpsertActor`

Upsert an actor by external_id. Creates on first call, updates on subsequent calls with the same external_id. Idempotent on `(community, external_id)`. Note: omitted fields on a follow-up call are overwritten with the new body — pass every field you want to keep on each call.

- Params: `Social.ActorCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (external_id, display_name, avatar_url length). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create` for this community. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in the PAK's workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const upsertActor = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").actors.create({ external_id: "user_abc123" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-actors)

### `social.community(…).actors.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors` → `PagePromise<Social.Actor>`

List actors in a community. 50 per page by default (max 200) — paginate with the cursor returned in `pagination.next_cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is true. Pass `?ids=<uuid,uuid,…>` (max 100) to batch-fetch specific actors instead — one hydration call for a screenful of ids; unknown ids are silently omitted and `pagination` is the exhausted shape (`next_cursor: null`).

- Params: `Social.ActorListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_CURSOR`, `INVALID_ID_LIST`, `TOO_MANY_IDS` | Invalid cursor (`INVALID_CURSOR`) — legacy raw-id cursors are rejected; restart from the first page and follow `pagination.next_cursor`. Or invalid `ids` (`INVALID_ID_LIST` — empty / non-UUID entry; `TOO_MANY_IDS` — over 100). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.list`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in the PAK's workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const actor of social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").actors.list()) {
  console.log(actor);
}
const page = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").actors.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-communities-community-id-actors)

### `social.community(…).actors.postState(actorId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors/{actor_id}/post-state` → `Social.PostState`

Batch viewer-state hydration: the actor's reactions, bookmark, repost, and poll-vote state for up to 200 posts in one call.

Read-over-POST (the id list is too large for a query string) — no side effects, no Idempotency-Key needed. Renders a whole feed page's "liked by you" / saved / reposted / voted state with one request on top of the feed call.

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const postState = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").actors.postState("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", {
```

## community(…).actors.drafts

### `social.community(…).actors.drafts.list(actorId, params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors/{actor_id}/drafts` → `PagePromise<Social.Post>`

Drafts are visible only via this endpoint — they're stripped from public feeds, lists, and `getById`. The PAK lane has no end-user principal, so the customer's backend is responsible for ensuring `actor_id` matches the end-user behind the request before exposing the response.

### `social.community(…).actors.hashtagFollows.create(actorId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors/{actor_id}/hashtag-follows` → `Social.HashtagFollow`

Follow a hashtag on behalf of an actor. Idempotent — re-follow refreshes the followed_at timestamp but doesn't error.

- Params: `Social.ActorHashtagFollowCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Tag fails the lowercase + alphanum + underscore + 1..32 rule. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community, actor, or hashtag not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const hashtagFollow = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").actors.hashtagFollows.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { tag: "storymode" });
```

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/actors/{actor_id}/notification-prefs` → `Social.NotificationPrefList`

List the actor's per-kind notification preferences. Synthesises `enabled=true` defaults for kinds the actor has not explicitly toggled.

Reverse-chronological inbox. Pass `unread_only=true` to filter to unread rows only. Cursor encodes `(created_at, id)` and round-trips through the response. Default page size 50, max 200. ```ts

## community(…).assets

### `social.community(…).assets.complete(assetId, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/assets/{asset_id}/complete` → `Social.UploadAsset`

Finalize a presigned-PUT video upload. Verifies the stored object (existence, size, container magic bytes) and enqueues the transcode. Replaying on a finalized asset returns its current status without re-enqueueing.

- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.assets.write`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Asset not found in this community. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `ASSET_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE`, `ASSET_TOO_LARGE`, `ASSET_INVALID_CONTAINER`, `ASSET_NOT_VIDEO` | `ASSET_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE` (no object / size mismatch — still retryable), `ASSET_TOO_LARGE` or `ASSET_INVALID_CONTAINER` (upload failed + object deleted), or `ASSET_NOT_VIDEO`. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const uploadAsset = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").assets.complete("eeeeeeee-0000-0000-0000-000000000001");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-assets-asset-id-complete)

### `social.community(…).assets.create(params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/assets` → `Social.UploadAsset`

Upload media. Images (multipart): processed synchronously, returns ready. Videos (JSON, kind:'video' + declared content_type/byte_size): returns an `uploading` asset with a presigned PUT — upload the bytes, then POST /assets/:id/complete.

- Params: `Social.AssetCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Missing/oversize/wrong-type file or declaration, or the bytes do not match the declared image type. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.assets.write`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or owner actor not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The image could not be decoded/processed. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED`, `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_UPLOADS` | `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_UPLOADS` — the community already has the max videos uploading/processing. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const uploadAsset = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").assets.create();
```

## community(…).connections

### `social.community(…).connections.accept(dstActorId, srcActorId, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/connections/{dst_actor_id}/{src_actor_id}/accept` → `Social.ConnectionResult`

Accept `src_actor_id`'s connection request as `dst_actor_id`: approves the follow request AND creates the reverse follow edge, so both directions exist afterwards. Convergent on retry — if the request was already consumed by a partially-completed accept (src already follows dst) the reverse edge is still ensured.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Malformed actor id. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community/actor not found, or no request to accept and src does not follow dst. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const connectionResult = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").connections.accept("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-connections-dst-actor-id-src-actor-id-accept)

### `social.community(…).connections.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/connections` → `Social.ConnectionResult`

Request a connection (mutual follow). Runs the standard follow path: a private destination yields `pending` (accept via the accept route); a public destination connects immediately — the reverse edge is created in the same call. Idempotent; refused on blocks (409) and self-connection (422) exactly like a follow.

- Params: `Social.ConnectionCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Missing / invalid src_actor_id / dst_actor_id. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or actor not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A block exists between the pair. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Cannot connect with yourself. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const connectionResult = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").connections.create({
  dst_actor_id: "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
  src_actor_id: "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-connections)

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/conversations` → `Social.Conversation`

Open a conversation. Default `kind="direct"` is the naturally-idempotent 1-on-1 path (get-or-create by participant pair). Pass `kind="group"` with `actor_ids` for a multi-participant chat — group creates always insert a new row, so pass an `Idempotency-Key` header to make group-create retries safe.

- Params: `Social.ConversationCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (missing recipient for direct, missing actor_ids for group, two equal actor ids, malformed Idempotency-Key). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`, or a participant is suspended. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or actor not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A block exists, the group exceeds `community.settings.max_group_conversation_size`, or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` (same Idempotency-Key, different body). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const conversation = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").conversations.create({});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-conversations)

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

## community(…).follows

### `social.community(…).follows.batch(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/follows/batch` → `Social.BatchFollows`

Bulk follow creation (max 200 per call) — the graph-import lane. Each item runs the exact single-follow path (block checks, counters, idempotency), so a blocked pair fails ITS item with a 409 in `error` while the rest of the batch proceeds. `201` even with failures — inspect per-item results. Set `suppress_notifications: true` when importing an existing graph.

- Params: `Social.FollowBatchParams`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Envelope validation failure: `follows` missing, empty, over 200 items, or an item shape invalid. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found in the PAK's workspace. (Unknown actors fail per item, not the whole call.) |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const batchFollows = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").follows.batch({
  follows: [
    {
      actor_id: "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
      dst_actor_id: "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
    },
  ],
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-follows-batch)

### `social.community(…).follows.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/follows` → `Social.FollowResult`

Follow another actor. Idempotent. If the destination is private (task 014), a follow request is created instead and the response is `{ status: "pending", edge: null }`; approve/decline it via the follow-request routes. Refused if either side has a block.

- Params: `Social.FollowCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Missing / invalid src_actor_id / dst_actor_id. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or one of the actors not found in the PAK's workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A block exists between the pair (in either direction). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Cannot follow yourself. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const followResult = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").follows.create({ dst_actor_id: "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000002" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-follows)

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts` → `PagePromise<Social.Post>`

List posts. Pass `author_id` to filter to a single author. 50/page (max 200), cursor-paginated.

- Params: `Social.PostListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.list`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const post of social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").posts.list()) {
  console.log(post);
}
const page = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").posts.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

Returns counts per option, zero-filling options that received no votes, plus `total_votes`. The `question` and option `label` strings are echoed from `post.attributes.poll`.

### `social.community(…).posts.recordImpressions(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/impressions` → `void`

Batch-increment impression (`view_count`) counters on a list of posts. Client-side debounced; missing post ids are silently skipped (so a deleted post mid-batch doesn’t fail the rest). Renamed from `POST /posts/views` (task 008 / G14) to disambiguate from the story-side per-post `/posts/:post_id/views` route.

- Params: `Social.PostRecordImpressionsParams`
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.recordImpressions({
```

### `social.community(…).posts.recordView(postId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/{post_id}/views` → `void`

Record a view of a post (idempotent).

Idempotent on `(community, viewer, post)`. 204 on success or no-op duplicate. 422 on self-view (you cannot view your own story). 404 if the post is hidden by visibility, expired, removed, or if a block exists between viewer and author. Does NOT fire a notification — the author sees views via the viewers endpoint instead.

- Params: `Social.PostRecordViewParams`
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Body validation failed. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.view`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community / post / viewer not found, or the post is invisible to the viewer. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Cannot view your own story. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.recordView("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", {});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-posts-post-id-views)

### `social.community(…).posts.repost(postId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/{post_id}/repost` → `Social.CreateRepost`

Repost a source post on behalf of an actor. Idempotent — returns the existing repost row with `created: false` on retry.

Visibility is inherited from the source. The reposter must be allowed to read the source (else 404). Self-repost 422; private-source repost 422. Bumps `source.repost_count` and the reposter's `post_count`. Fires a `repost` notification to the source author (subject to per-kind preferences from task 021).

- Params: `Social.PostRepostParams`
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community / source / actor not found, or source invisible to the actor. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | CANNOT_REPOST_SELF (reposting your own post) or CANNOT_REPOST_PRIVATE (source is visibility='private'). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const createRepost = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.repost("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", {});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-posts-post-id-repost)

### `social.community(…).posts.comments.create(postId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/{post_id}/comments` → `Social.Comment`

Add a comment on a post. Pass `parent_id` to reply; the depth is computed and capped by the community config. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

- Params: `Social.PostCommentCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (missing actor_id, empty body, body too long, malformed Idempotency-Key). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community, post, or parent comment not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Block exists between commenter and post author, depth exceeds community.settings.max_comment_depth, or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` (same Idempotency-Key, different body). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const comment = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.comments.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { body: "Looks great, shipping today." });
```

## community(…).posts.comments.reactions

### `social.community(…).posts.comments.reactions.create(postId, commentId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/{post_id}/comments/{comment_id}/reactions` → `Social.AddCommentReaction`

React to a comment. Idempotent: re-posting the same `(actor, type)` returns the existing row with `created: false`. Multiple reactions per `(actor, comment)` are allowed (different `type` values count separately).

- Params: `Social.PostCommentReactionCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (missing actor_id; empty / overlong type). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community / post / comment / actor not found, or comment is invisible to the actor. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Block exists between actor and comment author. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const addCommentReaction = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").posts.comments.reactions.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { type: "like" });
```

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/{post_id}/tags/{tagged_actor_id}/approve` → `Social.PostTag`

Approve a pending tag (tagged actor only).

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


## community(…).posts.votes

### `social.community(…).posts.votes.create(postId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/posts/{post_id}/votes` → `void`

Cast or change a vote on a poll.

Last-vote-wins: an actor changing their vote replaces the prior one. 422 if the post has no poll, if `option_index` is out of range, or on self-vote of own poll. 409 if a block exists between voter and post author. Fires a `vote` notification to the post author.

- Params: `Social.PostVoteCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Body validation failed. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.vote`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community / post / voter not found, or post invisible. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Block in place between voter and poll author. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `POLL_CLOSED` | Self-vote / no poll / option_index out of range / `POLL_CLOSED` (past the poll `closes_at`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


## community(…).restricts

### `social.community(…).restricts.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/restricts` → `Social.CreateEdge`

Restrict another actor (Instagram-style). One-directional. Restricted actors can still see content, but new comments by them are pre-moderated as `pending_approval` until the post-author approves.

- Params: `Social.RestrictCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Missing / invalid src_actor_id / dst_actor_id. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.create`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community or actors not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Block exists between the pair. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | Cannot restrict yourself. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const createEdge = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").restricts.create({ dst_actor_id: "aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000002" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-restricts)

## community(…).search.actors

### `social.community(…).search.actors.list(params, options?)`

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/search/actors` → `PagePromise<Social.ActorSearchHit>`

Search actors by display name, external_id (username), and bio.

Postgres FTS over a generated tsvector column (display_name A + external_id B + bio C, `simple` locale). Returns up to `limit` (default 20, max 50) hits ordered by `ts_rank`. Pass `actor_id` to filter out actors the requester has muted or blocked, and actors who have blocked the requester. Trigram fuzzy matching is intentionally out of scope — that's a follow-up.

- Params: `Social.SearchActorListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page
- Fills `actor_id` from `.as(actorId)`

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | q missing or out of bounds (1..120 chars). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.list`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found (or belongs to a different community). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const actor of social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").search.actors.list({ q: "onboarding" })) {
  console.log(actor);
}
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-communities-community-id-search-actors)

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/search/posts` → `PagePromise<Social.PostSearchHit>`

Search post content (title + body) by full-text.

Postgres FTS over a generated tsvector column on the post table (title A + body B, simple locale). `order='relevance'` (default) ranks by ts_rank; `order='recent'` keeps the FTS filter but orders by created_at desc. Filters out drafts / removed / hidden / expired posts. Pass `actor_id` to drop posts authored by anyone the requester has muted / blocked, or who has blocked the requester. Without `actor_id`, only posts with `visibility='public'` surface.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | q missing / overlong, or invalid `order` value. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK lacks `social.list`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const post of social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").as("7a8b9c0d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d").search.posts.list({ q: "onboarding" })) {
  console.log(post);
}
```

## community(…).webhooks.endpoints

### `social.community(…).webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Social.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Social.CommunityScopedWebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found, not visible to the caller, or the endpoint / event is not in it. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-webhooks-endpoints)

Delete a webhook endpoint.

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.endpoints.rotateSecret("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { grace_hours: 24 });
```

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
