|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found, not visible to the caller, or the endpoint / event is not in it. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventTypeList = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.eventTypes.list();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-communities-community-id-webhooks-event-types)

## community(…).webhooks.events

### `social.community(…).webhooks.events.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/events` → `PagePromise<Social.WebhookEvent>`

List webhook events, newest first (kept for 30 days).

Every event logged while at least one endpoint existed, with the latest state per endpoint and when the next retry is due.

- Params: `Social.CommunityScopedWebhookEventListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid filter value or cursor. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Community not found, not visible to the caller, or the endpoint / event is not in it. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const event of social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.events.list()) {
  console.log(event);
}
const page = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.events.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-communities-community-id-webhooks-events)

### `social.community(…).webhooks.events.replay(eventId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}/replay` → `Social.WebhookEventReplay`

Send a logged event again, to its endpoints or to one endpoint.

Same body and `webhook-id`, freshly signed, to every switched-on endpoint that receives this event type now, or only to `endpoint_id`. Waits for the receivers (up to 15 s each) and returns the attempts. A success cancels a retry still queued for that endpoint.

- Params: `Social.CommunityScopedWebhookEventReplayParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. Or No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `endpoint_id` is switched off or does not receive this event type (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventReplay = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.events.replay("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#post-v1-communities-community-id-webhooks-events-event-id-replay)

### `social.community(…).webhooks.events.retrieve(eventId, options?)`

`GET /v1/communities/{community_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}` → `Social.WebhookEventDetail`

Get one webhook event with every delivery attempt.

The event as it was sent (`type`, `data`) and every delivery attempt to every endpoint, with its trigger, HTTP status, error and the start of the response body. Use it to debug a receiver, then `replay` to send it again.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `social.read` (reads) or `social.update` (changes, Send test, replay). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventDetail = await social.community("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.events.retrieve("evt_3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/social/api-reference#get-v1-communities-community-id-webhooks-events-event-id)

## Error codes

`err.code` on an `APIError` is one of these (an open set: new codes may appear).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed (not valid JSON, a bad header, an unusable parameter). |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One or more request fields are invalid; `errors` lists each field (`param`, `message`, `code`). |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | No credentials, or the token or API key is invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | The workspace has no credit or plan for this operation. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The resource does not exist, or belongs to another workspace or app. |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | The route does not accept this HTTP method. |
| `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | The route cannot produce the requested content type. |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | The request took too long to arrive. |
| `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `GONE` | The resource existed but has been removed for good. |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | A precondition header did not match. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | The request body is over the size limit. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body is not in a content type the route accepts. |
| `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The request is well-formed but cannot be carried out. |
| `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` | The route requires a precondition header. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests; retry after the `Retry-After` header. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | An unexpected server error. Retrying is safe for idempotent requests; quote `request_id` to support. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | The server does not support this operation. |
| `BAD_GATEWAY` | An upstream service returned an invalid response. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service or one of its dependencies is temporarily unavailable; retry. |
| `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` | An upstream service did not answer in time; retry. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The workspace has not enabled this product. |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The credentials were not accepted. |
| `SESSION_REVOKED` | The session behind this token was signed out or revoked. |
| `MCP_NOT_PERMITTED` | An MCP (agent) token cannot call this route. |
| `MCP_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The MCP token was issued for a different workspace. |
| `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key cannot call this route. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_GRANTABLE` | The policy grants actions the caller does not hold. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | This operation requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds with the same key to get its response. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT` | The workspace has the maximum number of webhook endpoints. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook endpoint with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED` | The endpoint is not subscribed to this event type. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook event with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | The event type is not one this product sends. |
| `ASSET_INVALID_CONTAINER` | Uploaded bytes are not an MP4/MOV/WebM container. |
| `ASSET_INVALID_SIZE` | Video must declare a positive integer byte_size. |
| `ASSET_INVALID_TYPE` | The asset file type is not supported. |
| `ASSET_MAGIC_MISMATCH` | Asset file content does not match declared type. |
| `ASSET_NOT_OWNED` | The asset belongs to another actor. |
| `ASSET_NOT_READY` | The asset is still processing. |
| `ASSET_NOT_VIDEO` | Only video assets are finalized explicitly. |
| `ASSET_PROCESSING_FAILED` | Asset could not be processed. |
| `ASSET_TOO_LARGE` | The asset is over the size limit. |
| `ASSET_TRANSCODE_FAILED` | The video could not be transcoded. |
| `ASSET_UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE` | No uploaded file was found for the asset. |
| `CANNOT_QUOTE_PRIVATE` | Cannot quote a private post. |
| `CANNOT_QUOTE_SELF` | Cannot quote your own post. |
| `CANNOT_REPOST_PRIVATE` | Cannot repost a private post. |
| `CANNOT_REPOST_SELF` | Cannot repost your own post. |
| `COMMENTS_DISABLED` | Comments are turned off for this post. |
| `COMMENTS_FOLLOWERS_ONLY` | Only followers can comment on this post. |
| `COMMENTS_MENTIONED_ONLY` | Only actors mentioned in this post can comment. |
| `EDIT_WINDOW_EXPIRED` | The post can no longer be edited. |
| `INVALID_CURSOR` | The cursor is invalid; restart from the first page. |
| `INVALID_DATE_FILTER` | A date filter is not valid ISO 8601. |
| `INVALID_EXPAND` | Unsupported expand value. |
| `INVALID_IDENTIFIER` | An id in the path or query is not a valid UUID. |
| `INVALID_ID_LIST` | An id list is malformed. |
| `INVALID_NOTIFICATION_KIND` | Unknown notification kind. |
| `INVALID_ORDER` | The `order` value is not supported. |
| `INVALID_SEARCH_QUERY` | The search query is invalid. |
| `PIN_CAP_REACHED` | The post has the maximum number of pinned comments. |
| `POLL_CLOSED` | This poll is closed. |
| `QUOTE_NOT_ALLOWED` | The author has disabled quoting this post. |
| `QUOTE_REQUIRES_BODY` | A quote post needs a body. |
| `QUOTE_REQUIRES_SOURCE` | A quote post needs `source_post_id`. |
| `REPOST_NOT_ALLOWED` | The author has disabled reposting this post. |
| `SOURCE_POST_ID_REQUIRES_QUOTE` | `source_post_id` is only valid on a quote post. |
| `TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_UPLOADS` | The community has the maximum number of videos uploading or processing. |
| `TOO_MANY_ATTACHMENTS` | The post has too many attachments. |
| `TOO_MANY_IDS` | Too many ids in one request. |
